Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: illustrative automotive catalog photograph for Express Lyft, a premium chauffeur and group transportation website.
Primary request: a professional, elegant black EXECUTIVE MINI BUS in a full side profile, on a bright neutral studio background. Represent a mid-size group shuttle class with a compact American executive minicoach silhouette, approximately 8.5–9 metres long, with a short sculpted conventional hood and a distinct driver cabin integrated into a wider passenger coach body. Two axles, six large rectangular smoked-glass passenger windows, closed front passenger entrance, subtle luggage compartment seams, polished silver wheel hubs. Make it clearly a minibús ejecutivo, with rounded refined bodywork and balanced realistic proportions.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm pearl-grey studio backdrop and floor, approximately #E9E6E0.
Style/medium: high-end automotive product photography, photorealistic with believable physical geometry, clean black paint with clearly readable soft reflections and contours.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536x1024, exact full side profile, front pointing LEFT, camera perpendicular at mid-body height, complete vehicle centred horizontally occupying about 85% of image width, wheels baseline at 72% of image height, generous margins around vehicle.
Lighting/mood: bright broad studio lighting, soft contact shadow, crisp yet natural, upscale and welcoming.
Constraints: one vehicle only, closed doors, wheels straight, lights off. No particular manufacturer or company branding. This is a representative class illustration, not an assertion about an actual photographed company vehicle.
Avoid: long full-size touring coach, flat-front bus silhouette, school-bus styling, city transit bus, tiny passenger van, oversized mirror arms, unnaturally stretched body, airport or parking lot, people, buildings, props, text, badges, readable license plates, logos, watermarks.
